title: auth(2fa): TOTP enrollment names the issuer "Better Auth" (otpauth label and issuer) instead of the deployment's app name
body:
QA-source: #21720 · identity-auth.two-factor-enrollment-reveal · outside the item's clauses

Seen by lane L8 of the 17.7 pre-release run #21720 (subject `251a7dd4`); verifier V5 reproduced it: CONFIRMED, low (branding; no security impact). Predates 17.6.0. The clause A2 itself ("label names issuer + account") is satisfied; only the step's "(the app/user)" asks for the app name.

## Reproduction

Boot with `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`; admin `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email`; `POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/enable {"password":"…"}` → `totpURI` = `otpauth://totp/Better%20Auth:admin%40objectos.ai?secret=…&issuer=Better+Auth&digits=6&period=30`. Users' authenticator apps list the account under "Better Auth".

## Mechanism

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:3473-3478` calls `twoFactor({schema, accountLockout})` with no `issuer`, and the `betterAuthConfig` object (`:1458`) has no `appName`; better-auth falls back to `appName` → `"Better Auth"`. `AuthManager.getAppName()` (`:5663`, default `'ObjectStack'`, honouring `OS_APP_NAME` — "names the whole deployment, not just its mail", `packages/spec/src/system/email-config.zod.ts:19-21`) already exists and every auth email uses it; it is never passed to 2FA.
